rationale: Actual native Qwen producers retain per-stage response usage and propagate unknown categories across the whole task, including interrupted stages; WorkCycle copies those task receipts. Framework InvocationMeasurement/UsageObservation/Runtime inspector are not automatically composed into that native path. Existing shared category arithmetic may be reused only with equivalent empty-population and attempted-call semantics: sum_usage(()) returns mathematical zeros, whereas no native turns intentionally retain UNKNOWN. Prefer a bounded existing-record consumer and explicit task/invocation joins; do not blindly replace app aggregators or put general orchestration in Runtime. Dashboard projection consumes app JSON directly; broader application cohesion and normalized-consumer integration remain open.
duplicate_disposition: Existing sufficient owner; append-only evidence, no duplicate implementation, approval, grant, B-number or parent closure.
